ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a wild San Francisco show featuring a soaring Dark Star, an epic The Other One and mysterious guest improvisations that make it a must‑listen.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its exceptional clarity and immersive sound, thanks to the half‑track master transferred by Rob Eaton. Musically the performance shines after a rough opening, with a breathtaking Dark Star, a monster version of The Other One and exciting guest horns/violin that give the show a unique, jazz‑laden edge.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers gave 4–5 stars and consistently highlighted both superb soundboard quality and standout performances; the weight of positive comments yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note crystal‑clear, immersive audio with no major glitches; the half‑track master was expertly cleaned and transferred.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Begins a bit rough but quickly launches into a magical Dark Star that carries the energy through the rest of the set, delivering an exciting, jam‑heavy experience with guest musicians adding fresh color.
